purpose: Teach: 見知らぬ/さんざん/もどる/気まま/だんだんと/何気なく/アナタ/ありとあらゆる

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、見知らぬお客様、迷ってお店に入ってきたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: A stranger wandered in by accident earlier today.
lines.style: Soft observation, gentle pacing. Speaking half to herself, noticing something small but meaningful. Warm undertone — the quiet satisfaction of seeing someone lost find their way.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、新メニューにさんざん文句を言われたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: A customer complained about the new menu. Quite a bit, actually.
lines.style: Dry, knowing smile in the voice. Light and unbothered on the surface — the practiced ease of someone used to difficult days. Slight exhale of amusement underneath.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様がお店にもどるかしらね、メイちゃん
lines.en: I wonder if they'll come back.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost wondering aloud. Not worried — just genuinely curious. Soft fade at the end, like she's turning it over in her mind without needing an answer.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、気ままに過ごせる時間って大切よね、メイちゃん
lines.en: It's nice to have time to just... be, you know?
lines.style: Quiet realization. Speaking slowly, finding the words as she goes. Tender and a little vulnerable — admitting something she doesn't often say out loud. Warm breath behind it.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、だんだんとお店が忙しくなってきたね、メイちゃん
lines.en: The shop's been getting busier lately.
lines.style: Simple observation, no performance. Factual but with a note of quiet noticing — not complaining, just marking the shift. Steady pace, grounded.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、何気なく外を見たら、お祭りの行列だったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: I glanced outside just now and there's a whole festival procession out there.
lines.style: Bright moment breaking through — genuine delight. Quicker tempo on the revelation. Eyes-widening energy in her voice. Still warm but suddenly more alive.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、アナタの作るケーキ、いつも美味しいわよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: The cakes you make are always delicious.
lines.style: Direct, sincere compliment delivered without ceremony. Warm and matter-of-fact — not flattery, just honest truth. Steady eye-contact in the voice.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、ありとあらゆるドリンクを試してみたいわね、メイちゃん
lines.en: I'd love to try all kinds of drinks someday.
lines.style: Soft wistfulness mixed with quiet ambition. Gentle, not urgent. A small dream said aloud — hopeful but patient. Slight smile under the words.
